buildcapture.capture.too_small: Cannot shrink by %s block(s) (%s): the box would end up empty.
buildcapture.capture.out_of_bounds: The selection cannot go past the build height (0-%s).

key.buildcapture.capture_face_edit: Edit the box / turn the preview (hold)

buildcapture.capture.aim_at_block: No block in reach. Look at a block within 16 blocks and try again.
buildcapture.capture.not_found: Structure %s is not loaded. Capture it first, or run /capture reload.

buildcapture.capture.structure_block: A structure block is inside the selection. Move it outside and try again.

buildcapture.capture.nothing_to_undo: Nothing to undo in this session.
buildcapture.capture.undo_restored: Restored the previous %s from its backup.

buildcapture.capture.gui.title: Build Capture
